ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: a modification of a Load Facility enters the ERCOT interconnection process
ercot.printed: A modification of any existing Load Facility that increases the aggregate peak Demand of the Facility by 75 MW or more

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: a Large Load asks to be studied as a Provisional Controllable Load Resource (Form W, Part A, to the DSP or TSP)
ercot.printed: Part A ... submitted to the Interconnecting DSP or Interconnecting TSP on or before July 10, 2026.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: the DSP or TSP sends Form W to ERCOT
ercot.printed: The Interconnecting DSP or Interconnecting TSP must submit the form to ERCOT on or before July 24, 2026.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: the TSP updates a Large Load's information after a material change
ercot.printed: The Interconnecting TSP shall update any project information ... within ten Business Days of being notified by the ILLE of a material change.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: the DSP or TSP tells the ILLE that ERCOT classified its load as studied, not base load
ercot.printed: the Interconnecting DSP or Interconnecting TSP, as applicable, shall notify the ILLE within two Business Days of receipt of ERCOT's classification notice.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: the ILLE disputes the classification
ercot.printed: the ILLE must notify ERCOT through its Interconnecting DSP or Interconnecting TSP no later than three Business Days after receiving notification.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: the ILLE posts its financial security
ercot.printed: The ILLE shall have seven Business Days from the date of notification to post the financial security required by paragraph (1)(c) of Section 9.2.1.2.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: the DSP or TSP tells ERCOT the security is posted
ercot.printed: The Interconnecting DSP or Interconnecting TSP, as applicable, must inform ERCOT within two Business Days of the ILLE posting the required financial security.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: ERCOT gives the Batch Zero Interconnection Study report
ercot.printed: ERCOT shall provide the Batch Zero Interconnection Study report to all Interconnecting DSPs and Interconnecting TSPs on or before April 9, 2027.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: ERCOT completes the refinement study and gives the Batch Zero transmission plan to the RPG
ercot.printed: ERCOT shall complete the Batch Zero Refinement Study and provide a Batch Zero transmission plan to the Regional Planning Group (RPG) ... on or before 90 days following the deadline in paragraph (c) above.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: the TSP gives ERCOT its short-circuit study report (before the transmission plan's date)
ercot.printed: The Interconnecting TSP must complete the short-circuit study ... and provide a study report to ERCOT at least 60 days prior to the date specified in paragraph (2)(d) above.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: a TSP gives ERCOT its transmission improvement cost estimates
ercot.printed: Each TSP shall provide any Transmission Facility improvement cost estimates within 10 Business Days of ERCOT's request.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: a PCLR is energized, its consumption capped at its Low Power Consumption until it qualifies (no duration stated)
ercot.printed: The Large Load shall not consume at a level greater than the maximum Low Power Consumption (LPC) amount documented in the updated LCP attested to by the ILLE per paragraph (4) of Section 9.4

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: legacy process: the lead TSP schedules the kick-off meeting
ercot.printed: Within ten Business Days of this notification, the lead TSP shall schedule a kick-off meeting with ERCOT and the certificated DSP to occur soon thereafter.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: legacy process: the lead TSP drafts the preliminary study scope
ercot.printed: The lead TSP will develop a preliminary LLIS study scope within ten Business Days following the kickoff meeting.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: legacy process: the lead TSP submits the final study scope
ercot.printed: Upon closing of the comment period described in paragraph (7) above, the lead TSP shall, within ten Business Days, submit a final study scope

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: legacy process: ERCOT approves or returns the final study scope
ercot.printed: Within five Business Days of the lead TSP submitting the final study scope, ERCOT shall approve the final study scope or return the scope to the lead TSP with comments.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: legacy process: a project not meeting Section 9.10 may be cancelled
ercot.printed: If the requirements of Section 9.10 have not been satisfied within 180 days after the communication of the completion of the LLIS by ERCOT ... ERCOT may notify the lead TSP that the project is subject to cancellation.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: legacy process: a load not energized a year after its study's date may need parts restudied
ercot.printed: If the Large Load has not met the requirements for Initial Energization ... within 365 days after the Initial Energization date identified in the LLIS study report, the lead TSP shall provide an opinion to ERCOT on whether any of the completed LLIS elements require restudy.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: legacy process: ERCOT reviews the preliminary study report (extendable by 20 Business Days)
ercot.printed: ERCOT shall review the preliminary study report within ten Business Days ... ERCOT may extend this review period by an additional 20 Business Days

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: legacy process: the lead TSP prepares the final study report
ercot.printed: the lead TSP shall prepare a final LLIS study report that incorporates all relevant feedback received in paragraph (2) above within ten Business Days.

ercot.document: ERCOT Planning Guide, Section 9, Large Load Interconnection or Modification
ercot.step: legacy process: ERCOT acts on the completed study
ercot.printed: Within ten Business Days following the completion of the LLIS, ERCOT shall:

ercot.document: PUCT Project No. 58000, Proposal for Publication of amendments to 16 TAC 25.192 and 25.193 and new 25.252 (Large Load Customer Tariffs), for the 9 July 2026 open meeting (a proposal)
ercot.step: a large load customer signs an interconnection agreement of at least twenty years (proposed)
ercot.printed: An interconnection agreement for service with a term of not less than 20 years and that complies with 25.194 of this title (relating to Large Load Interconnection Standards) is required.

ercot.document: PUCT Project No. 58000, Proposal for Publication of amendments to 16 TAC 25.192 and 25.193 and new 25.252 (Large Load Customer Tariffs), for the 9 July 2026 open meeting (a proposal)
ercot.step: the customer pays on its contracted peak demand for twenty years from the start of billing (proposed)
ercot.printed: For the first 20 years after commencement of billing, the large load customer must complete 240 consecutive payments based on the greater of: (A) the large load customer's contracted peak demand; (B) the highest non-coincident peak demand placed by the large load customer on the system in the past year; or (C) the large load customer's 12CP demand

ercot.document: PUCT Project No. 58000, Proposal for Publication of amendments to 16 TAC 25.192 and 25.193 and new 25.252 (Large Load Customer Tariffs), for the 9 July 2026 open meeting (a proposal)
ercot.step: billing begins when transmission capacity is available, whether or not the customer has energized (proposed)
ercot.printed: irrespective of whether the large load customer has energized or is fully using available capacity

ercot.document: ERCOT, Large Load Update, Board of Directors hearing, 1 April 2026 (the batch study framework)
ercot.step: the large loads seeking interconnection, as ERCOT counted them (a statistic, not a rule)
ercot.printed: ERCOT is tracking approximately 410 GW of Large Loads seeking interconnection of which ~87% are data centers.

ercot.document: ERCOT, Large Load Update, Board of Directors hearing, 1 April 2026 (the batch study framework)
ercot.step: large load requests are clustered and studied together, twice a year
ercot.printed: Every ~6 months, all submitted requests are clustered and studied together; allocated capacity coming out of the study is "reserved" to prevent restudies
